title: EXP-011/012 implement persistent browser-owned frames and input
description: Keep one Jolt model alive across requestAnimationFrame callbacks, prove callback/owner identity and prompt return, then use browser automation for deterministic pointer, keyboard, viewport, and canvas resize transitions.
acceptance_criteria: One module survives at least 600 frames; automated input and resize produce deterministic state plus visibly inspected before/after screenshots with no owner-thread, GC, page, worker, or WebGL errors.

title: EXP-010 render and inspect the first Jolt-driven Raylib frame
description: Make Jolt own diagnostic state and drawing choices, render through the verified facade, and execute PLAN.md first-frame browser automation and semantic screenshot inspection.
acceptance_criteria: All first-frame acceptance bullets in PLAN.md pass: revision text, dimensions, distinctive background, two primitives, legible text, mutable Jolt value, clean browser diagnostics, matching readiness, and hashed inspected screenshots.

title: EXP-009 implement and verify the minimal Jolt Raylib facade
description: Implement only the project-owned Jolt declarations and ergonomic wrappers needed for the diagnostic scene. Keep portable app code separate and verify every emitted Chez signature against EXP-006.
acceptance_criteria: Native/static checks cover the minimal wrapper API, all FFI declarations map to verified pb prototypes and ownership rules, and the complete Raylib-Jolt suite is not pulled into the Wasm payload.

title: EXP-008 run the pure Jolt payload in an automated browser
description: Run the Node-proven Jolt payload in the real browser without graphics. Publish stable DOM startup/result/failure state and exercise Unicode, persistent collections, atoms, exceptions, and repeated calls.
acceptance_criteria: Browser results match native/Node fixtures, automation sees explicit readiness, and no page, worker, or Wasm errors occur, or a reduced blocker is retained.

title: EXP-007 render one Chez-driven Raylib browser frame
description: Combine the automated Chez browser runtime, plain Raylib baseline, and static facade so Scheme values select visible frame content while C only schedules and bridges.
acceptance_criteria: Changing only a Scheme value visibly changes an automated, vision-inspected canvas screenshot; exact owner and diagnostics are retained.

title: EXP-006 prove a static registered Chez pb FFI facade
description: Statically link and register a tiny C facade in the Chez Emscripten module. Build the Jolt→Chez→pb prototype→C matrix and test no-arg, integer, unsigned, pointer, UTF-8, and memory ownership shapes without Raylib.
acceptance_criteria: Every required facade signature has an independent passing witness using stock pb prototypes, or each missing prototype is reduced and wrapper/command-buffer alternatives are measured before patching Chez.

title: EXP-005 prove plain C Raylib web rendering with screenshots
description: Build pinned Raylib PLATFORM_WEB without Chez, use a browser-owned main loop, render the fixed diagnostic scene, and validate it only through browser automation plus page/canvas screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Automation observes readiness and clean console/network state; a vision-capable agent records that expected text, colors, and geometry are visible in hashed screenshots.
notes: EXP-005 observed success. Validation: nix flake check --no-build; VERIFY_BROWSER=1 nix develop -c ./scripts/verify; locked Chromium 152.0.7977.64 reached DOM readiness, reported no page errors/request failures, and captured hashed page/canvas screenshots. Vision inspected page.png: dark page/title, dark-blue canvas, green circle, blue + yellow rectangles, and legible Raylib/frame text. Exact details/hashes in experiments/EXP-005-raylib-web/README.md.
close_reason: Plain C pinned Raylib PLATFORM_WEB browser baseline validated with real-browser automation, screenshots, and visual inspection.

title: EXP-003 audit Jolt on native tpb32l Chez
description: Before Wasm graphics, load the smallest Jolt host/kernel and selected conformance forms on native portable-bytecode Chez. Inventory 32-bit, adapter, thread, filesystem, subprocess, and FFI failures by layer.
acceptance_criteria: Reader/value/collection/eval witnesses run on the intended machine family, or the first incompatibility is reduced and documented with no-patch control evidence.

title: EXP-004 run a pure Jolt boot payload under Node Wasm
description: Cross-mint a target-compatible Jolt application boot, package it with Chez --emboot, and compare canonical pure-Jolt EDN fixtures under Node to native Jolt. Do not add Raylib.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical outputs match native fixtures and the target survives repeated allocation, or a reduced JOLT_CHEZ_HOST/JOLT_THREAD_CAPABILITY blocker is preserved.

title: EXP-002 prove stock Chez portable bytecode in an automated browser
description: Serve the EXP-001 output over loopback HTTP, prove browser completion with automation, capture errors and a screenshot, and verify crossOriginIsolated plus COOP/COEP when using pthreads.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned browser automation observes the completion token with no uncaught page/worker errors and retains metadata and an inspected screenshot, or records a reduced browser blocker.

title: EXP-001 prove stock Chez portable bytecode under Node
description: Build unmodified pinned Chez through its documented Emscripten path and run deterministic pb and candidate tpb32l boot witnesses under Node. Record machine type, arithmetic, allocation/GC, output, and exit status.
acceptance_criteria: A fail-fast reproduction from the pinned shell runs the exact boot payload under Node or preserves a reduced CHEZ_EMSCRIPTEN blocker with logs and revisions.

title: Prove Jolt + Chez Wasm + Raylib browser feasibility
description: Execute the evidence ladder in PLAN.md without substituting another runtime. Coordinate source pins, reduced experiments, browser visual proof, owner-thread safety, and the final graded report.
acceptance_criteria: Child evidence establishes the highest honest W0-W6 level; every browser-rendering claim has automated screenshots and vision inspection; source and Beads state are pushed.

title: Scaffold pinned toolchain, repository hierarchy, and diagnostics
description: Implement PLAN.md Phase 0: Nix pin boundary, pins.edn, bootstrap diagnostics, experiment template, source/test/docs README hierarchy, ignore rules, and native Jolt test/nREPL witness.
acceptance_criteria: From a clean clone the pinned shell reports required versions, a native Jolt test passes, loopback nREPL starts, all created source subdirectories have scoped READMEs, and exact evidence is recorded.
notes: Completed Phase 0 scaffold in source commit pending: locked Nix shell builds pinned Jolt (including required submodule), pins.edn, docs/source/test hierarchy, EXP-000 record, bootstrap, native test, and loopback nREPL smoke. Validation 2026-08-31: nix flake check --no-build; nix develop -c ./scripts/verify (bootstrap, one-test native Jolt witness, loopback TCP nREPL); bd lint; pi-lens diagnostics clean.
close_reason: Phase 0 scaffold acceptance met with exact commands and recorded EXP-000 evidence.

title: Publish Beads task dashboard to GitHub Pages
description: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that exports the Beads dashboard and publishes it under /bv/, matching the sibling project pattern while targeting this repository.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow triggers on Beads state/workflow changes and manual dispatch, pins the Beads Viewer release, exports static HTML, and deploys the dashboard and repository-root redirect to gh-pages.
notes: CI regression corrected: `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` exported 16 issues and the tracked JSONL now lets Beads Viewer run without bd in Actions. Workflow now triggers on that export, verifies it is nonempty, then exports static pages. Validation: bv v0.22.0 exported from both workspace and --db .beads/issues.jsonl to /tmp/bv-output; git diff --check; bd lint; YAML diagnostics clean.
close_reason: Workflow exports Beads HTML to gh-pages /bv/, publishes repository-root redirect, and README links to the read-only dashboard.

title: Run stress, size, clean-room verification, and final report
description: Execute PLAN.md stress/capability matrix and fail-fast clean-room tiers, preserve PASS/FAIL/SKIP logs and visual evidence, then write an evidence-bounded REPORT.md with the achieved W0-W6 level.
acceptance_criteria: Clean clone verification produces per-tier logs and summary; required screenshots are vision-inspected; performance data includes declared environment/method; REPORT.md links reproducible evidence and states limitations without overclaiming.

title: EXP-013 prove debug-only live browser redefinition
description: Implement a bounded debug evaluation queue processed by the frame owner. Redefine a pure Var-backed function in the same page/module while retaining a startup-captured stale control and state continuity.
acceptance_criteria: Automation records same-instance before/after visual change without reload/rebuild, the dynamic Var changes, stale control does not, state survives, owner identity is stable, and release export audit finds no eval bridge.
